## Core capabilities

- Company Intelligence and system provenance
- AI agent and MCP integration
- Plugin and skill packaging
- Evidence-led technical audits
- Digital worker / Neural Workforce composition
- Agent/API distribution and marketplace architecture
- Applied AI learning infrastructure
- AI creation control-plane workflows

## Evidence First

Runtime state, source identity, security, commercial truth and customer relationships are kept separate.

A live deployment is not an external certification.
A solution match is not a customer relationship.
A target company or accelerator is not a partner unless externally confirmed.
Watched or pending financial values are not settled revenue.
